title: Mark Elements on Array by Performing Queries
summary: Given an array of positive integers and a series of queries, mark elements according to the queries.
statement: Given an array of positive integers and a series of queries, mark elements according to the queries. For each query, mark the specified index and the smallest unmarked elements as per the query's count. Track the sum of unmarked elements after each query and return these sums.
constraints: nums contains positive integers; all elements begin unmarked.
Each query first marks its stated index if needed, then marks up to count smallest unmarked values, breaking value ties by smaller index.
Return the sum of all unmarked values after every query.
hints: A global value/index ordering never changes; only marked entries become ineligible.
Sort once, advance one cursor past marked entries, and maintain the remaining sum.
Mark the query index conditionally; then scan sorted pairs until count new indices are marked; append remaining sum.
The cursor encounters every unmarked candidate in exact tie-breaking order, and conditional subtraction removes each value from the sum once.
editorial: The cursor encounters every unmarked candidate in exact tie-breaking order, and conditional subtraction removes each value from the sum once.

tests.explanation: The remaining sums after the three rounds are eight, three, and zero.
The first query marks values five and one, leaving six; the repeated index is already marked, then value two is marked, leaving four.
